title: Cryo chambers on Mars

tellings.quote: they did report that there were cryo chambers on Mars and that there were people who had been left there

plain: Somewhere on Mars, the story goes, there are cryo chambers, sealed rooms where people were put into a deep frozen sleep and left behind. The researcher Jason Jorjani says this on the show, passing on what he says remote viewers reported. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a distant place by the mind alone, and Jorjani names Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, as his source. If true, it would mean people were once on Mars and some never left.
